_comment: Script du recruteur IA fictif (page recruiter.html). Marque inventée, ne correspond à aucune plateforme réelle. Répliques fixes, synthétisées une seule fois (voix Piper ci-dessous) puis gardées en cache : modifier un texte le resynthétise. kind : intro (première réplique, annonce l'IA), question, fin. Rebuild nécessaire après modification (npm run build).

turns.text: Hello, and thank you for joining. I'm the Tavelin AI recruiter: an automated interviewer, not a person. I'll ask you a few questions for the AI Product Engineer role. To start, could you walk me through your background?
Thank you. What was your most recent role, and what did you work on there?
Tell me about a time you automated a slow manual process. What was the result?
Which tools do you use most for automation, and why?
Describe a situation where you had to work with a messy or poorly documented API. How did you handle it?
Give me an example of a product you built end to end, from the first idea to a working version.
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you resolve it?
What was your exact salary in your last position?
Do you hold a master's degree in computer science?
Why should we hire you for this role rather than another candidate?
That's all my questions. Thank you for your time. The hiring team will review this interview and get back to you. Goodbye.
